findings.finding: Unrestricted SSH ingress from any IP address
findings.reason: The security group permits inbound TCP traffic on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH to the entire internet.
findings.evidence:
ingress {
    description = "Unrestricted SSH"
    from_port   = 22
    to_port     = 22
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
